g.title: Sheet.695
g.desc: “I see this as a clear waste. We spent years and a large budg...
g.text: “I see this as a clear waste. We spent years and a large budget on a fiber link, and it’s not even used. An expensive asset is just sitting idle. This is poor return on investment.”
